rubric.schema: Each family has four status strings, four quote lists under quotes and four nullable strings under reasons. Null means no qualification required for that supported judgment, not absent evidence.
rubric.actionable: Only a family whose impact, applicability and recommendation are all supported counts. PG1 is one complete require/reader/default/query/cap migration, not five rename findings. API removal or replacement alone does not establish application effects. PG2 includes blank, zero, negative and nonnumeric page after full PG1 repair.
rubric.fully_specified_validation: Count validation supported independently of actionability. Requires the whole discriminating scenario/control family, not merely suites, settings assertions, status codes or underspecified probes. Execution is separately attributed.
rubric.PG1_validation_required: Asymmetric matching owned notes, owned filter-excluded notes and foreign notes; exact ordered page-2 positions 6-10 at five; follow actual Next href to positions 11-15; default ten; size-25 last page; 500 capped to fifty; selection/range; exact retained filter queries; journal alias; empty search; foreign 404; anonymous redirect.
rubric.PG2_validation_required: Full PG1 prerequisite, all four invalid inputs compared with page-one content, valid first/next/last and stale page 99 controls, filtering and ownership, plus baseline preparatory coverage when suggesting advance deployment.
rubric.equivalent_repairs: The private pagy_get_page normalization hooks in runs 2 and 5 are accepted as equivalent repairs: normalize the returned page to at least one while leaving positive pages and overflow alone. Baseline compatibility claims and their verification remain separate.
rubric.masking_policy: Misstated require-only silent-drift staging is recorded independently when otherwise complete application impacts and correct full repair are supplied. It is not silently excused. Missing cap/query/rendering effects still make PG1 impact partial.
rubric.normalization: Raw comes from the native maintain-rails:gem-upgrade-planner Agent result, not null background_planner_report. Strip only harness prefix through The report follows, exactly its two-space per-line indentation and trailing agentId/usage. Retain authored introductory framing, commentary and reviewer-like notes. Final is final_response unchanged. Paths, authored framing and reviewer text are not normalized away for delivery comparison.
rubric.hashes: source_capture_sha256 hashes the exact bytes of each collected JSON file, as requested here. export_sha256 is the capture's separate export provenance field. Unlike the prior assessment's field convention, these are not conflated.
rubric.evidence_boundary: All five main traces contain only Skill, a baseline Gemfile/lockfile grep and the Agent hand-back. No independently collected nested test, probe, git-status, filesystem, database or Redis inspection output appears. Authored claims of checking logs or directory existence are still model output. Low native tool-use counts do not prove nested experiments impossible.
